data.name: Haafiz
data.gender_notes: Haafiz is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Haafiz is an Arabic name that means 'protector of the Quran' or 'one who memorizes the Quran'. It is a title given to those who have memorized the entire Quran. The name Haafiz carries the meaning “Protector of the Quran” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Haafiz usually hope their child will grow to embody protector of the quran and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Haafiz is considered a sacred title, symbolizing the guardian of the divine revelation.
data.etymology: Haafiz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector of the Quran.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haafiz total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: حافظ
in_arabic.long_meaning: حافظ: من حفظ القرآن الكريم أو حفظ الحديث أو حفظ الكتب العلمية. يعد حفظ القرآن الكريم من أهم الأمور في الإسلام، وقد جاء في القرآن الكريم: "وَلَقَدْ يَرْجُونَ أَن تَكُونَ لَهُمْ فِتْنَةٌ فَلَن تَكُونَ لَهُمْ فِتْنَةٌ إِلَّا وَيُصْلِحَ اللَّهُ أَمْرَهُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ شَكُورٌ خَلِقٌ " [الفرقان:20].

in_urdu.name: حافظ
in_urdu.meaning: قرآن و سنت کو محفوظ رکھنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: حافظ: وہ شخص جس نے قرآن پاک یا حدیث یا علم کے مجموعہ کو محفوظ رکھا ہو. حفظ قرآن پاک کا اہمیت اسلامی تعلیمات میں ہے. قرآن پاک میں یہ ذکر ہے: "وَلَقَدْ يَرْجُونَ أَن تَكُونَ لَهُمْ فِتْنَةٌ فَلَن تَكُونَ لَهُمْ فِتْنَةٌ إِلَّا وَيُصْلِحَ اللَّهُ أَمْرَهُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ شَكُورٌ خَلِقٌ " [الفرقان:20].

in_hindi.name: हाफिज़
in_hindi.long_meaning: हाफिज़: वो व्यक्ति जिसने कुरान को या हदीस को या विद्या का संग्रह को सुरक्षित रखा हो. कुरान को सुरक्षित करना इस्लामी शिक्षाओं में बहुत महत्व का है.

in_pashto.name: حافظ
in_pashto.long_meaning: حافظ: دا وو کسان چې قرآن یا سنې یا علمي کتابونو پاملارځي. د قرآن پاملارنه داسلامي تعلیماتو کې ډیر ضروری ګڼل کېږي. د قرآن په کلام کې داسلامیانو ته دا خبره ده: "وَلَقَدْ يَرْجُونَ أَن تَكُونَ لَهُمْ فِتْنَةٌ فَلَن تَكُونَ لَهُمْ فِتْنَةٌ إِلَّا وَيُصْلِحَ اللَّهُ أَمْرَهُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ شَكُورٌ خَلِقٌ " [الفرقان:20].

in_english.name: Haafiz
in_english.meaning: Protector of the Quran and Sunnah
in_english.long_meaning: Haafiz: One who memorizes and protects the Quran, Hadith, or scientific knowledge. Protecting the Quran is a significant aspect of Islamic education. In the Quran, it is mentioned: "And they expect that there will be a torment, but Allah will rectify all their affairs; surely Allah is Grateful, the Creator. " [Furkan:20].

data.cultural_impact: The title Haafiz has significant cultural importance as it highlights the importance of memorizing and preserving the Quran in Islamic tradition. In many Muslim communities, becoming a Haafiz is a great achievement and source of pride. Haafizes are respected individuals who hold a deep understanding of the Islamic scripture and its teachings. This cultural significance also extends beyond individual achievement, as communities often come together to support and encourage one another in their quest to memorize the Quran.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, being a Haafiz is a sign of devotion, dedication, and a deep connection with Allah (God). The memorization of the Quran is seen as a means of connecting with the divine, and Haafizes are said to be closer to Allah due to their extensive knowledge and understanding of the Islamic scripture. Furthermore, memorizing the Quran is an act of worship in itself, with the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) stating that "the one who recites the Quran and understands it will be in the company of the angels." (Bukhari and Muslim). Thus, the spiritual significance of the title Haafiz is multifaceted, encompassing personal growth, deep spiritual connection, and a sense of oneness with Allah.
